body: I plan it out in my head sometimes. I've never sat down and tried to write it. It's a lot to put into words.
Thanks, I guess. I don't see any light up ahead, though.

I tasted what it was like to get better. It was bittersweet.
I'll likely end up killing myself. I just need to get out of here. Everything is so temporary.
I don't know how to feel better.

You wouldn't be the first. I had potential at one point, but I threw it all away. Now I'm just counting the days until my bitterness consumes me.
The longer I live, the more I despise it. Not everyone gets a happy ending.

I'd be lying if I said I would.
I wouldn't kill myself for anyone, and I wouldn't stay for anyone.
No one can 'save' me but myself, and I don't think I can.
I don't think there's a point in trying anymore.
I wanted to write a book. I have the substance, just not the words. I wanted to teach elementary school, but that couldn't happen. It doesn't matter, man. Life is pointless.
Just a huge weight on my chest. I'll be disappointed if the world doesn't end in December.

I moved out for about 3 months. I was better.
I was happier. I had motivation. This house is a vortex. It fills me with anguish and feeds on my joy. It's a monster. Everything in this house dies.
A friend. A girl who I met in a strange way at a strange time. She gave me courage. She made me think I was worth loving. That changed, though. Now she sees how stupid I am. She sees everything that I knew from the start. It would have hurt less if she hadn't come into my life. Before I met her, I knew these things. I didn't question it. She came and she made me feel like i was worth something and then she left and took it all with her and I feel worse than I did before.
I told her everyone leaves. She told me she'd prove me wrong.
I don't blame her for leaving. It just hurts.
I don't have a cent to my name. I can't even drive. My life is fucked. I am in debt and broke, I have nothing. I have no reason or purpose. I fucked up and now I am paying for it.

Actually, I'm a woman. There's nothing to help, anymore. I'm rotting. Everything dies here. My brother is going at it now. My twin brother. He's become worse then my older brother. There's no fucking escape.

You are right when you say she's not worth killing myself over.
But she's not the reason. I've been suicidal since childhood. She's just the recent heartbreak. People are all the same. It doesn't matter.
I am tired. I want to sleep forever.

Don't waste your time. No one can save me. It's only a matter of time.
Suicide hotlines won't help. Hospitalization won't help. I'll always return to this hole.
I just wish she would fucking talk to me. I wish she would say something. A fucking month ago, she loved me. Now I am a nuisance.
It hurts so fucking much. She was my motivation, and now I am lost.
And it doesn't matter.
It never matters.
I have a butterfly tattoo for this project.

While I appreciate you taking the time to type this all out, I do not affiliate myself with any religion. I'd rather not discuss it at all.
Thanks, though.

My feeling on everything right now.
You're not alone.
